summary: Seller Wizard V2 testing complete. Backend: 18/18 API tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 5 wizard steps verified with correct UI elements, 60/40 layout, sidebar navigation, live preview, and design system compliance. Teaser generation working (AI-powered). Infomemo generation API working but takes longer (30+ seconds).

backend: GET /api/cif/B12345678/lookup - valid CIF returns result with found, source, company_info, financials
GET /api/deals/{id} - get deal details with teaser
frontend: Wizard renders at /seller/onboarding with sidebar and 60/40 layout
Wizard renders at /seller/company/:companyId for existing companies
Step 0 (Datos Basicos): CIF input, BUSCAR EN REGISTRO button, legal name, country, city, website, trade name, founded year, employees, agency type, categories, description, highlights

Step 1 (Financieros): Year inputs (revenue, EBITDA, recurring %, concentration %, growth %), add/remove year, valuation factors (founder dependency, revenue type, main clients, retention, tech assets, IP)
Step 2 (Valoracion): Displays valuation range (2.8M - 3.8M EUR), EBITDA multiple, factors considered
Step 3 (Acuerdo): Operation type checkboxes (full_sale, partial_sale, merger), asking price with suggested range, negotiable checkbox
Step 4 (Teaser & Infomemo): GENERAR TEASER button, GENERAR INFOMEMO button, teaser preview with regenerate, infomemo editor with toggle preview
Sidebar step navigation works (can go back to completed steps)
Step indicator at top shows correct progress with checkmarks for completed steps
Live Preview updates dynamically with form data (name, description, revenue, EBITDA, employees, valuation)
Next/Previous navigation saves data at each step
Design system: 0px border-radius, ALL CAPS labels (label-arroba), ghost inputs with bottom border, arroba-coral color, PRIVADO/PUBLICO badges, coaching tip

critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar navigation only allows going to completed steps (i <= step) - this is correct behavior but may confuse users who expect to freely navigate
Infomemo generation can take 30+ seconds - consider adding a progress indicator or background generation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seller Wizard V2 fully tested. The wizard has 5 steps: Datos Basicos (company info + CIF lookup), Financieros (financial data + valuation factors), Valoracion (calculated valuation display), Acuerdo (deal configuration), Teaser & Infomemo (AI-generated content). All backend APIs working: /api/companies CRUD, /api/companies/{id}/financials, /api/companies/{id}/calculate-valuation, /api/cif/{cif}/lookup, /api/deals CRUD, /api/teaser/generate/{companyId}, /api/infomemo/generate/{companyId}. Frontend uses 60/40 split layout with live preview. Design system 'The Digital Artifact' implemented (0px border-radius, IBM Plex Sans, ALL CAPS labels, ghost inputs). Teaser generation is fast (~5 seconds), infomemo generation takes longer (30+ seconds, AI-powered via GPT-5.2).
